public.title: Tree Containment
public.description: parents is a rooted tree encoded by parent indices, root parent -1. Return whether ancestor is a strict ancestor of node; a node does not contain itself. Indices are valid. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.

explanation: Follow parent links until the requested ancestor or root sentinel is reached. O(h) time and O(1) space for height h.
